summary: Seniority dispute between direct recruits and promotees for ACF post; 50:50 recruitment ratio under 1998 Rules; training period as part of probation for direct recruits; 1984 Rules proviso excludes training period for DFO promotion eligibility; government resolution cannot override statutory service rules; Tribunal allowed salary payment from training date but High Court restricted seniority impact to DFO promotion; Ajara precedent distinguished for lack of equivalent government resolution.
legal_provisions_cited: Assistant Conservator of Forests in Maharashtra Forest Service (Recruitment) Rules, 1998 Rule 6; Rule 3(b)
Divisional Forest Officer (Recruitment) Rules, 1984 Rule 2(B) proviso
Maharashtra Civil Services (General Conditions of Services) Rules, 1981 Rule 10
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; Tribunal's salary payment direction upheld but seniority fixation modified; High Court judgment partially set aside regarding DFO promotion eligibility criteria.
